tasks.description: Optimize frontend code to reduce load times and improve responsiveness. Focus on reducing unnecessary re-renders and minimizing DOM manipulations. Use tools like Webpack and code splitting to optimize bundle sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the homepage, when the page loads, then the load time is under 2 seconds

tasks.description: Implement caching mechanisms to reduce the load on the backend and improve response times. Focus on caching frequently accessed data and using caching layers like Redis or Memcached.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user makes a repeated request to the same endpoint, when the response is returned, then the response time is under 500ms

tasks.description: Optimize database indexes to improve query performance and reduce latency. Focus on indexing frequently accessed columns and using efficient indexing strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the query time is under 100ms

tasks.description: Develop a dashboard to monitor and track performance metrics, such as load times, response times, and error rates. Use tools like Grafana or New Relic to visualize performance data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the performance dashboard, when the dashboard loads, then the dashboard displays current performance metrics

tasks.description: Develop automated tests to measure performance and identify bottlenecks. Use tools like JMeter or Gatling to simulate user traffic and test performance under load.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs the performance tests, when the tests complete, then the tests report performance metrics

tasks.description: Identify and optimize slow database queries to improve performance and reduce latency. Use tools like EXPLAIN and query analysis to identify bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the query is executed, then the query time is under 50ms

tasks.description: Set up a content delivery network (CDN) to reduce latency and improve load times for static assets. Use tools like Cloudflare or Akamai to distribute content.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a static asset, when the asset is delivered, then the asset is delivered from a nearby CDN node

tasks.description: Set up alerts and notifications to notify the team of performance issues and bottlenecks. Use tools like PagerDuty or Splunk to monitor performance metrics and trigger alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a performance issue occurs, when the alert is triggered, then the team is notified of the issue
